message.text:
Two protocols are identified. gRPC-Gateway and Connect are registered by RegisterGateway. Connect replaces grpc-web for browser clients.

Native gRPC registration is being verified. The Connect handler adapts existing gRPC service implementations. The exact file path for native gRPC server registration is still unknown.

gRPC-Gateway (REST HTTP) — v1.go via RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer
ConnectRPC — connect_handler.go via NewMemoServiceHandler, wrapped in connect_services.go

q19.
gRPC-Gateway — server/router/api/v1/v1.go
Connect — server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go

`RegisterGateway` in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go` mounts MemoService on HTTP REST via `v1pb.RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer`. Connect is registered in `server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go` with `apiv1connect.NewMemoServiceHandler`; `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go` wraps those Connect calls onto `APIV1Service`. There is no native `grpc.NewServer` registration.
